Annual date

A Hebrew day begins at sunset the evening before. Your calendar events mark the daytime date.

Date rules

Birthday mode uses the Hebrew birth year to handle Adar and missing 30ths automatically. A missing 30th moves to the 1st of the next month. Yahrzeit calculations require the original Hebrew year and use Hebcal’s rules for Adar and missing dates. Customs vary; check the preview against your practice. For annual dates, Adar becomes Adar II in leap years; Adar I and II become Adar in common years. Missing 30ths follow your selected option. Skipped years do not count toward repetitions.

Dates are calculated in your browser and are not uploaded. Calculations by Hebcal. Exports support Gregorian years 0001–9999.
